title: The Fulda protest of 1576: a ciphered note in the Bavarian key volume, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 f.129 (DECODE R9325; catalogue 161)

steps.what: Web search for KAA 4591 and Augurelio ciphers
DECODE record list from the API dump (141 records in the volume); images of the 14 targets and 30 neighbouring keys fetched with the cookie
R9325 matched to key R9324 by identical null signs; applied

R9325 deciphered sign by sign with R9324: every word Latin; slips secr(e)to, iuxilio for auxilio, uoluid for voluit; the nomenclator gives Pontifex, Abbas Fuldensis, Consiliarii Caesaris, Dux Bavariae, Nuncius Apostolicus (r9325/reading.txt)

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from kaa4591 (catalogue 161), whose fourteen records are letters in at least six systems: System A′ stays in kaa4591; Łaski's System B is kaa4591b; R9325 is fulda1576; R9367, R9416, R9424 and R9319 are r9367, r9416, r9424 and r9319; R9291 is a key fragment. decode.py written: the key applied to the transcription gives the reading except 18 of 270 signs (c/o look-alikes, the writer's slips, and line 4, whose transcription keeps a first pass); reveal and signs.txt from it.

outcome.method_basis: Key R9324, filed a few leaves earlier in the same volume, was matched to R9325 by its identical null signs and applied unchanged.
outcome.fraction_read_source: r9325/reading.txt: every word of the plain column read (three scribal slips: secrto, iuxilio, uoluid)
outcome.notes: The note concerns the deposition of Abbot Balthasar von Dernbach of Fulda by his chapter and knights with Julius Echter of Würzburg (1576); dated from the nomenclator and the content.

credits.note: key R9324 in the same volume

prior.where: No decipherment on the record; no edition found (web search 2026-09-21). The key R9324 is filed in the same volume.
